pages.text: The Eclipse Alloy Paxel represents the pinnacle of tool integration, combining the functionality of a pickaxe, axe, and shovel into a single formidable tool. $(br2)Craft it either by combining an Eclipse Alloy Pickaxe, Axe, and Shovel in a Upgrade Station, or upgrade a $(l:tool_celestigem_paxel)Celestigem Paxel$(/l) using the Upgrade Station. Both methods preserve any installed upgrades.

pages.title: Upgrade Station Recipe
pages.text: Combine the matching pickaxe, axe, and shovel in the Upgrade Station.

pages.title: Upgrade Station Recipe
pages.text: Upgrade this item in the Upgrade Station.
